combined_hash_definition: sha256 over newline-joined '<repo-relative path>:<sha256>' entries, sorted by path; an empty file list is refused

defect.summary: docs/RESULTS_s1.md reports a combined figure hash equal to the SHA-256 of the empty string, because the results document was generated from an integrity manifest built before the figures existed.

relationship_to_original: Additive only. artifacts/s1/integrity_manifest.json is left exactly as written on 2026-09-07 and is not corrected in place. docs/RESULTS_s1.md is likewise unchanged. This file supplies correctly computed figure hashes and records the defect for the historical record.
